title: Flat affine section modules give flat stalk modules
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and G a quasi-coherent O_Y-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose that for each affine open V of Y the section module G(V) is flat over O_Y(V), with scalars restricted along the equal-open appLE of the identity. For every point x of Y, the module-stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] applied to G is flat over O_Y,x.

source.place: Tag 01U4, implication (2) to (1), specialized to the identity morphism; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01U4

proof.text: Choose an affine open neighbourhood V of x using exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. Install the section module structure appearing in hflat and the actual germ algebra O(V) -> O_x. Apply hflat V.

Module.Flat.baseChange makes O_x tensor_{O(V)} G(V) flat over O_x. The affine tensor-presentation theorem identifies this constructed tensor product with the module stalk over O_x; transport flatness by Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01U4, (2) to (1), affine localization and flat base change; second reading replaces an equivalent-flat-module restatement by a genuine tensor presentation

lean.statement:
theorem flat_stalk_of_affine_sections_flat {Y : Scheme.{u}} (G : Y.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G]
    (hflat : ∀ V : Y.affineOpens,
      letI : Module Γ(Y, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) :=
        Module.compHom _ ((𝟙 Y : Y ⟶ Y).appLE V.1 V.1 (le_rfl)).hom
      Module.Flat (Γ(Y, V.1)) (Γ(G, V.1))) (x : Y) :
    Module.Flat (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace x).obj G)
